about_me: A highly motivated First-Class Computer Science graduate with a strong passion for building efficient and user-focused web applications. Possesses hands-on experience with modern frontend technologies including JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and React, alongside practical knowledge of API integration and version control systems. Eager to apply problem-solving skills and a proactive attitude to contribute to dynamic web development teams, continuously learning and delivering high-quality user experiences.

projects.title: Decentralised Milestone Tracker
projects.b1: Engineered a full-stack web application using React, Astro, and TypeScript for the front end, and a Solidity smart contract for the backend.
projects.b2: Utilised Firebase as a NoSQL database for project data and IPFS for decentralised storage of files whilst using middleware to protect all critical API routes.

projects.title: Game Mod Loader
projects.b1: Developed a GUI application to streamline launching game modifications for the Dolphin emulator.
projects.b2: Has a Rust backend with a React and Typescript front end, using Tauri for cross-platform support.

work_exp.title: Games Tester
work_exp.b1: Identified, documented, and tracked software defects in games using a proprietary bug tracking system.
work_exp.b2: Collaborated effectively with colleagues to replicate issues and verify bug fixes.

work_exp.title: Warehouse Operative
work_exp.b1: Managed daily intake and processing of corporate records, ensuring 100% accuracy in logging and inventory management.
work_exp.b2: Maintained strict adherence to data protection protocols, safeguarding sensitive materials throughout storage and retrieval processes.

paragraphs: I am writing to express my keen interest in the React Developer position at React HQ. As a First-Class Computer Science graduate, I am eager to apply my strong foundation in web technologies and a genuine passion for the React ecosystem to a role where I can contribute to innovative front-end solutions.

My academic background and personal projects demonstrate practical experience with React and TypeScript. The 'Decentralised Milestone Tracker' involved building a full-stack web application using React and Astro, while the 'Game Mod Loader' showcased my ability to develop cross-platform GUI applications with a React and TypeScript front end. These projects have equipped me with robust skills in component development, state management, and API integration.

I am impressed by React HQ's focus on advancing the React framework and delivering exceptional user experiences. My proactive approach to learning and problem-solving, coupled with a commitment to writing clean, efficient code, makes me confident I can contribute effectively to your team. I am keen to develop my expertise further within a company at the forefront of web development.
Thank you for considering my application. I am available for an interview at your earliest convenience to discuss how my skills and enthusiasm can benefit React HQ.
